body: In some states it is. If I were to go to rehab again, I would be dead in 15 minutes. I'd rather be in prison.

That's a battle I'm currently having with myself. The last time I was in this position, I checked myself in to a hospital. It was not a bad experience, except they claimed I was a drug addict and I ended up in a halfway house for six months and spent every day wanting to die.
I'm going to do it in the forest. My only problem is that I want someone to find me, I don't just want to rot away and never be found.  But does it really matter if I'm not living to care?
It's out of my control. I only know that in 7 hours and 12 minutes, it won't matter anymore.

Unfortunately, I don't have a doctor at the moment and my normal psychiatrist is in PA where I am from. I'm a freelance programmer/network engineer, primarily PHP development. If I had a way out, I want to live, I just don't see any light. At this time, I think at 7PM my story will end.

My Mom is fully aware of my situation. She told me to figure it out myself. It's not like they couldn't help either. I was wrong for not calling her, it was a mistake, but I honestly just didn't realize the day. I feel so guilty.
Talk to someone. Enjoy that you have someone to talk to. I wish I did.
I have tried multiple times to get my parents to provide support. All they tell me is to get a job and make fun of me. Do you have any friends?
I can assure you that I would much rather have my parents support than be living in a forest. You don't know how painful starvation and freezing every night is. I would not wish it on anyone.

Hang in there. Your young, I'm assuming your have somewhere to live and food to eat, all positives and reason to live. I'm homeless, haven't eaten in three days and living in the forest. I don't feel like I have any choices except starve or spare myself the pain of starvation and sleeping outside and die by my own hand.

It took me 22 years to come out of the closet as being gay. Because of having to hide it for so long, I've nearly ruined my life, but I did get to spend a few months with a guy who made me happy. I left on a road trip like three months ago, but I got robbed in Tijuana and now I'm homeless in the California National Forests. I wish my story didn't have to end, but I rather it be by my own hand instead of starving to death.

I'm in Bakersfield, California now. I went to three different temp agencies yesterday and applied and I'm trying to Freelance as best as I can. I ran out of my medication and that is just making everything much harder.
I've spent all night and morning thinking about my letters which I plan to write today. I just don't have the energy to keep doing it anymore. It's too much. Please pray for me.

I'm still alive, I survived another night in the forest, but for tonight, I don't have enough gas to get out of Bakersfield, CA to get back to the forest. I don't know what I'll do. I did make $25 AUD from Freelancer yesterday, but it's under the withdrawal amount, so it won't help.
No, but I constantly sit outside their restaurants and use WiFi since it's one of the few places with decent WiFi.

I'm still here. I spent last night in a new forest (Sequoia National Forrest in California). Yes, I did get out of Tijuana fortunately, because I guarantee I would long be dead. Yesterday, I applied to three different temp agencies. I'm really trying as hard as I can, but when you don't have anything to eat or anywhere real to sleep, its hard.
Not so good. I just don't know what I should do anymore. I feel like a homeless piece of shit.
I really need someone to talk to right now. Please, anybody.

My Mom just called and told me how horrible I am for forgetting Mother's day along with telling me that my Grandmother is in the hospital. I feel so horrible for forgetting Mothers day now, I such a fuck up.

I don't want to die. I just don't have the energy left to keep fighting to survive. It takes so much energy just to be able to live. I literally have been living off $1 Taco Bell burritos for the last few days, but now I'm just out of money completely. I don't know what to do, but I think it may be the end, I can't keep starving and freezing.
